# Test fixtures

`words/<tag>.txt`: the distinct words of five letters or more in the
Universal Declaration of Human Rights, one file per language, for the
differential tests against other hyphenators. The texts are the UDHR in XML
project's (github.com/eric-muller/udhr, commit
`588b3f4b2d0467aff54842a4b926551b69d5a66a`, `data/udhr/udhr_<code>.xml`),
whose translations come from the Office of the United Nations High
Commissioner for Human Rights, which lets the Declaration be reproduced
freely.
